# VANDA

> It blooms through stone.

VANDA is a 3,333-piece NFT collection of orchid specimens on BNB Smart Chain
(BEP-721). Sequential Accession Nº 001–3,333. First mint FREE for any SPACE ID
Agent ID holder. Max 6 per wallet.

- Site: https://vanda.vercel.app/
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (BSC mainnet, chain ID 56), BEP-721
- Language: English only
- Status: PREVIEW — contracts not deployed yet

## Spec

- Supply: 3,333, sequential IDs 1–3,333
- Tiers: Common "Vanda Alba" 1–1,666 (1,666) / Uncommon "Vanda Rosea"
  1,667–2,499 (833) / Rare "Vanda Coerulea" 2,500–2,999 (500) / Epic "Vanda
  Aurea" 3,000–3,249 (250) / Legendary "Miss Joaquim" 3,250–3,333 (84)
- Price ladder (per wallet, cumulative): #1 FREE, #2 0.0005, #3 0.001, #4
  0.002, #5 0.003, #6 0.005 BNB; max 6/wallet; max 0.0115 BNB/wallet
- Batch cost = ladder sum of the next prices (never price x qty)
- Gate: SPACE ID Agent ID for every mint (no allowlist)
- Token $VANDA: 1,000,000,000 total (540,000,000 pool / 460,000,000
  treasury), 120,000 per paid mint, max 600,000 accrued per wallet
- Royalty: 5% to the owner; marketplace: own escrow, 0% fee (seller 95% /
  royalty 5%)
- Owner / treasury: 0x7379CA652f68fd1daAc11b7b87bb6B222fD129fa
- baseURI: https://vanda.vercel.app/metadata/
- X: TBD — official account coming soon, no handle yet

independent project on BNB Chain, not a Binance collaboration.
